style: Quiet, desolate instrumental music inside an immense abandoned archive. Sparse felt piano, a cold slowly evolving analog synthesizer pad, deep sustained cello and distant glass bells. A lonely minor melody suspended over a low drone, slow tape echoes, long dark reverberation. Intimate and still, a faint mechanical tick in the distance. No drums. Purely instrumental. Cm, 126 BPM.
